description: Machine registry of the 76 stable normative requirement IDs of the Controller requirement-policy map (.factory/requirement-policy.json, schema ralph-requirement-policy/v1). The deterministic parser (.factory/loop/plan_parser.py) loads the policy map as the acceptance boundary and rejects any conformance matrix that misses, duplicates, or exceeds these IDs (PLAN-01, Task 18 item 3). This flat registry mirrors the policy's ID set in policy order for tooling that consumes a flat ID list; the parser verifies the two agree and fails closed on divergence. The requirement-policy map is the separate authority for required evidence tiers.
